args.sql:
SELECT 
    rm.riskandmarginpivot AS risk_profile_id,
    rm.ordervault AS related_order,
    ab.accountbalancesnode AS account_balance_id,
    rmp.margin_rates->>'margrate' AS margin_requirement,
    rmp.collateral->>'collsum' AS margin_balance,
    rmp.collateral->>'insfundshare' AS margin_usage
FROM 
    riskandmargin rm
JOIN 
    accountbalances ab ON rm.riskandmarginpivot = ab.accountbalancesnode
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(rm.risk_margin_profile) AS rmp;
